items.text: ETR had Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY; Schefter and Rapoport confirmed ACTIVE for MNF vs Cowboys (prior hamstring, recent back notation). Eagles also activated other IR pieces.
items.why: Official Eagles inactives showed Barkley up; Rapoport noted same with Dickerson/Stowers.
items.implication: Lead back role returns; full or near workload expected after missing prior games.
items.opportunity: Carries, RZ/goal-line, snaps restored; reverse any prior backup elevation.

items.text: ETR listed Puka Nacua as GTD/OPTIMISM pregame; Schefter and Rapoport confirmed he was officially ACTIVE vs Raiders despite calf injury after Saturday improvement and no setbacks.
items.why: Optimism from feeling better Saturday; sources said available absent setbacks; official active confirmation.
items.implication: Full or near-full WR1 role expected; no reverse of prior beneficiary upgrades.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets as primary; ceiling intact with Stafford.

items.text: ETR had Breece Hall as GTD/PESSIMISM; Rapoport said unlikely (limited participant, early in return from quad); Schefter confirmed officially INACTIVE.
items.why: Not full participant yet after missing three games with quad strain; workout possible but sources leaned out.
items.implication: Missed Week 7; committee or backup elevation for Jets RBs.
items.opportunity: Handcuff/backup snap share, carries, routes spike in his absence.

items.text: ETR summary listed Lamar Jackson OUT for the weekend games.
items.why: Weekend injury reports summary from ETR; prior limited practice/ankle context from earlier reports.
items.implication: Ravens offense without Jackson; Huntley or backup QB implications for Henry/Likely/etc.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/RZ and pass-game volume shifts to remaining skill players.

items.text: CMC suffered mild hamstring strain (initially thigh) vs Falcons, returned to game; Shanahan 'pretty optimistic' he'll be fine post-Week 8 bye. ETR watching list noted quad/return. Schefter confirmed return in-game.
items.why: Returned after locker room; coach optimism for post-bye; player said he'll be alright.
items.implication: Bye provides recovery; expected available Week 9; monitor workload ramp.
items.opportunity: Unchanged long-term role; short-term rest benefit. Backup touches if limited early return.

items.text: Levitan: Think Cam Skattebo is actually hurt (hamstring), but not certain. ETR watching list with Tracy hamstring; earlier Rapoport context on Skattebo as lead back.
items.why: Post-game assessment that injury is real though severity uncertain.
items.implication: Possible limited role or absence next; monitor practice/status.
items.opportunity: If limited/OUT, backup Giants RB snaps/carries/routes elevate.

items.text: Levitan on Gibbs ankle turned during purposeful slide: almost certainly fine. Would have been tilting if he injured himself avoiding a TD. ETR watching list included it.
items.why: Slide was purposeful and correct; Levitan assessment post-game that injury risk low.
items.implication: No expected absence or major role change; continue as RB1.
items.opportunity: Unchanged snaps/carries/routes/RZ; monitor practice next week.

items.text: ETR listed DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT. Berry noted no Smith & Wicks boosts slot opportunity (Lemon bet) vs Cowboys defense strong vs slot.
items.why: Weekend reports summary; confirmed in context of MNF inactives/activations.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth thinned; targets/routes redistribute to remaining pass-catchers including Goedert and slots.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets/RZ for healthy Eagles pass-catchers; third-down/two-minute usage up.

items.text: ETR listed Josh Jacobs IN; Schefter actives confirmation; Berry discussed ROS fantasy value post-return after layoff.
items.why: Return to field confirmed in reports and actives; Packers RB back.
items.implication: Workload resumption; monitor snap/carry share vs committee.
items.opportunity: Carries, RZ/goal-line touches restored; Packers OL notes (Rhyan high-ankle) may affect.

items.text: Berry: Can we PLEASE put some respect on Tee Higgins’ name? (post-performance call for recognition).
items.why: Strong recent play warrants more fantasy respect/start consideration.
items.implication: Higher in weekly rankings/start-sit; Burrow connection reliable.

items.text: Levitan: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value-touch thesis. Arguably worst runner efficiency (dead last YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet fantasy RB13 PPR PPG via 9 inside-5 carries and league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Volume in RZ and targets overrides poor per-play efficiency; data from SumerSports/NGS.
items.implication: Sustainable fantasy floor/ceiling via opportunity despite inefficiency; hold/start confidently in PPR.
items.opportunity: Continued high RZ carries, targets, third-down; role secure.
items.conflict: Efficiency metrics conflict with fantasy output; pure yards chasers may undervalue.

items.text: Berry: Tony Pollard EXPLODED on Sunday. If you can turn that big game into a sell-high opportunity in fantasy, I’d take it.
items.why: Outlier explosion performance; trade value peaked for ROS sustainability concerns.
items.implication: Sell in dynasty/redraft if offer strong; monitor usage sustainability.
items.opportunity: Current carries high but may regress; handcuff/backup watch.
items.conflict: Recent production vs longer-term role/efficiency questions.

items.text: Levitan Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24, Noel 15 (left early turf toe), Hutchinson 15, Boutte 13, Marvin Harrison 8, Tank Dell 6 (first game since 2024).
items.why: Clear route lead for Collins; Dell limited in return; Noel exited.
items.implication: Nico remains alpha; Dell ramp-up slow; Noel turf toe watch.
items.opportunity: Collins high routes/targets; if Noel/Dell limited further, more for Hutchinson/others.

items.text: Levitan Chiefs WR routes (2nd game without Rashee Rice): Xavier Worthy 33 of 36 Mahomes dropbacks, then Royals 24, Armstrong 20. Note: Worthy never topped 83 rec yards in 37 prior games.
items.why: Route dominance in Rice absence; historical yardage ceiling caution.
items.implication: Volume opportunity elevated short-term; efficiency/ceiling may cap weekly upside.
items.opportunity: Routes, targets, deep shots with Mahomes; monitor if Rice returns.
items.conflict: High routes vs career rec-yard max under 83; volume alone may not yield WR1 weeks.
